summary: Tested the 4 libranzas follow-up features plus regression. Backend: 52/52 pytest passed, made up of 20 new tests in test_license_rest_iter36.py, 21 earlier license-rest tests and 10 trusted-driver tests. One run had a single transient failure (no-auth 401), which then passed in 3 reruns and by curl. (1) GET /rides/client/available-drivers: no auth gives 401, a driver token gives 403 and a bad 'at' gives 422. The count matches the pure rules for now and 4 ISO times. Inserted TEST drivers change the count as expected: a working driver in shift adds 1; weekly rest, out of shift, propietario and an empty licence add 0. (2) GET /license-rest/calendar: no licence gives {known:false, days:[]}. With licence 99998 the result equals month_calendar(); Monday weekly rests are 06:00-06:00 with ends_next_day=true, weekend rests are 07:00-20:00 on odd dates, and 2026-11-09 has both holiday and weekly. Month 0 and 13 give 400; no auth gives 401. (3) /me rest_soon was tested at unit level by calling my_rest_status with a frozen clock. 45 min before gives rest_soon with minutes_to_rest=45. Exactly 60 min gives true/60. 61 min gives no flag. While resting there is no flag. The live /me call is consistent. Frontend (mobile 390x844): the banner showed 'Libranza desconocida' before. Right after saving licence 99998 in Editar Perfil it switched to 'Hoy libras / Libras hasta mañana a las 06:00 (libranza semanal)' within 2.5s, with no 60s wait. LicenseCalendar: with no licence the placeholder shows. With licence 99998, November shows Mondays in red and odd weekend days in blue; 09/11 is red with a purple dot. The detail panel lists both rests for 09/11, 'Puedes trabajar todo el día' for 10/11 and the weekend rest for 07/11. Next/prev move through Dec 2026, Jan 2027 and Oct 2026, and the detail resets on month change. Client: shows '2 taxistas disponibles ahora' for ASAP; it is hidden in Reserva mode until date and time are chosen, then shows '4 ... a esa hora' (tomorrow 08:00) and '3 ... a esa hora' (22:00). All match the backend's expected counts for the same 'at'. Regression: the trusted-driver toggle text ('libra hasta ...' wording fixed), the banner, and the collapsible HolidaysAdmin (14 rows when expanded) all work.

minor.issue: Counts every registered user with a licence (including admin and test, never-logged-in or inactive accounts), not drivers who are online or active. This follows the agreed rule but may overstate real availability. It also scans the whole users collection on every call; consider a projection, index or short cache.

issues: At 390px the title 'Mis libranzas' wraps onto 2 lines next to the month navigator (fixed width 120).
When a weekly rest and a holiday fall on the same day, the cell is red and the holiday shows only as a 5px purple dot, so holiday purple is hard to notice.
The frontend still requires a licence ('Nombre y licencia son obligatorios'), so the backend change that allows clearing the licence cannot be used from the UI.

action_items: Optional: decide whether available-drivers should only count recently active drivers (for example last_seen within N days).
Optional: stop the calendar header wrapping on mobile; make holiday days more visible when they overlap a weekly rest.
Optional: allow an empty licence in handleUpdateProfile if clearing is intended.
critical_code_review_comments: count_available_drivers loads up to 20000 users per request and runs license_status for each. This is fine now but should be cached for 60s per time bucket.
LicenseCalendar and EmisoraClient build dates from the device timezone (new Date(...)). This is fine for Madrid devices; in the UTC test browser, 'tomorrow 08:00' was sent as 08:00Z (09:00 Madrid).
LicenseCalendar calls the calendar endpoint even when licenseNumber is empty (load runs before the early return). This is harmless.
seed_data_creation: TEST_avail_* users were inserted and removed by the fixture. The client sessions +34600999401/501/502 were reused and TEST rides were cancelled with ui_setup_trusted cleanup. Admin was restored (license_number unset, preferred_shift=day).
flaky_tests: test_license_rest_iter36::TestAvailableDrivers::test_no_auth_401 failed once in the first full run (1 of 4 runs), likely a transient ingress or cold-start response; it passed in every later run and by curl.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The container clock is Mon 2026-11-02 (holiday). Licence 99998 rests on Mondays and on odd weekend or holiday dates. The client UI session comes from 'python tests/ui_setup_trusted.py sessions > /tmp/sess.json'; set the localStorage keys appRole=client, emisora_client_token and emisora_client_info. The driver UI uses appRole=driver plus admin/admin; open the profile by clicking the 'admin' text, then 'Editar Perfil', the 'Solo números' input and 'Guardar'. The rest_soon banner text (license-rest-soon) was not visible live because no rest starts within 60 min of the test time; it was verified at unit level only.
